title: Lenny's Podcast drops Eric Ries: 'the force that no one controls but everyone obeys'
summary: Lenny Rachitsky — host of the top startup/product podcast — releases a 99-minute conversation with Eric. Lenny's framing of the two books: 'The Lean Startup was about helping you build a successful company. Incorruptible is about helping you protect what you've built.' 1.9K views and 107 likes in the first four hours.
blockquote: We all know this force. In the book I call it the force that no one controls but everyone obeys that tends to drag organizations down into mediocrity to the point that we lose control of them. Now, sometimes we lose control of them because we get fired. You know, we get ousted from our own company. Sometimes it happens because we're like Frankenstein and his monster. It starts to become malign or bureaucratic or frankly evil and we can't figure out how to stop it.
